# Step - cast

`cast` · category: [Strings and type conversion](../../traversal/step_reference.md#strings-and-type-conversion)

Converts the value to the given GType (number, string, boolean, uuid, list, map), optionally with a CastPolicy for values that do not convert.

## Forms

```text
cast(arg1: GType)
cast(arg1: GType, arg2: CastPolicy)
```

## Example

```rhai,graph=modern
g.inject("1", "2").cast(GType.LONG).sum().next()   // 3
```
